## Market.getAccrualBorrowRates() method

Returns the rates that \_would\_ apply to interest accrual for borrowers of this market, if `accrueInterest` was called at the given timestamp (scaled by WAD).

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected getAccrualBorrowRates(timestamp?: BigIntish): {
        elapsed: bigint;
        avgBorrowRate: bigint;
        endBorrowRate: bigint;
        endRateAtTarget?: bigint;
    };
```
